spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 22}):

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast {@spell Shatter|SRD52} (level 3 version).

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 16}, reach 15 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d8 + 9}) Slashing damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Lightning damage.

action.name: Lightning Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 23}, each creature in a 120-foot-long, 10-foot-wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Line}. {@actSaveFail} 88 ({@damage 16d10}) Lightning damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

legendary.name: Cloaked Flight
entries: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast {@spell Invisibility|SRD52} on itself, and it can fly up to half its {@variantrule Fly Speed|SRD52}. The dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary.name: Sonic Boom
entries: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast {@spell Shatter|SRD52} (level 3 version). The dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary.name: Tail Swipe
entries: The dragon makes one Rend attack.

Ancient blue dragons think beyond dominating groups of short-lived servants. Instead, they seek to claim their places above other dragons and their world's most powerful inhabitants. If world domination seems too tedious or cliché, these dragons might seek to seize control of extraplanar realms, multi-world empires, or forces of reality—like life, storms, or time itself.

items.title: Shattering the enemy's defenses, an ancient blue dragon leads its armies in conquest
